name: Cogniosynthesis Portal
description: Digital ecosystem support, analytics and reporting: AI Exploration · AI Health Check · Epistemic Audit. In your building, offline. Every one starts with a conversation. Cogniosynthesis Portal Ltd, Cardiff. A UNESCO-MOST BRIDGES Coalition member.
slogan: AI Exploration · AI Health Check · Epistemic Audit

hasOfferCatalog.name: Three ways we help with AI

itemOffered.name: AI Exploration
itemOffered.description: For anyone not sure what AI could do for them. A half-day in your building, offline, and a short written plan: what AI could take on, and what to keep human.

itemOffered.name: AI Health Check
itemOffered.description: For anyone already using AI. A day in your building, offline. We review your AI set-up from what you show us in the room: settings, policies, supplier terms and exports, and note what they say about who has access, where data goes and how long it is kept.

itemOffered.name: Epistemic Audit
itemOffered.description: An epistemic audit checks what a policy, notice or contract claims to know, and what it leaves out. One written finding per document, with the source in your own text. In your building, offline.
